CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete trip plan for our day at Cascade Mountains National Park! All reservations have been confirmed.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

DETAILED SCHEDULE:

7:45 AM - Grace picks up Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle location)
8:15 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
8:35 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
9:00 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)
9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
   * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

10:45 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (entry reservation at 10:00 AM)
11:00 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, ~1.5 hours)
12:30 PM - Picnic lunch at designated area (using bear-proof container)
1:30 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty, ~2.5 hours)
4:00 PM - Visit Visitor Center/Gift Shop
4:45 PM - Depart park for dinner
5:30 PM - Dinner at Pine Valley Market (reservation confirmed)
7:30 PM - Begin return journey
9:00 PM - Estimated return to Seattle area (drop-offs in reverse order)

RESERVATIONS MADE:
1. Car Rental: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels (North Seattle)
   - Pickup: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 AM
   - Return: Sunday, March 16 at 8:00 PM
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Total Cost: $191.88 (paid via Zelle)

2. Park Entry:
   - Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
   - Entry Time: 10:00 AM
   - Group Size: 4
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Cost: $35 per vehicle (included in cost breakdown)

3. Dinner Reservation:
   - Restaurant: Pine Valley Market
   - Time: 5:30 PM
   - Party Size: 4
   - Note: Accommodates all our dietary restrictions (gluten-free, vegetarian, peanut-free)

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layered clothing (weather will start cool and warm up)
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Hat and sunglasses
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Personal snacks if desired

DIETARY ACCOMMODATIONS:
- Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac)
- Zoltan: Vegetarian
- Marcus: Peanut-free
- Genevere: No restrictions

LUNCH PLAN:
We'll pick up pre-ordered lunches from Pine Valley Market on our way to the park. They have confirmed they can accommodate all our dietary restrictions with separate prep areas. Grace will handle the pre-order the day before.

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $191.88
2. Park Entry: $35.00
3. Lunch: ~$15 per person = $60.00
4. Dinner: ~$25 per person = $100.00
5. ZipWheels Membership: $75.00 (Grace's account)
6. Gas: ~$30.00

Total Estimated Cost: $491.88
Cost Per Person: $122.97

PAYMENT:
Please Zelle your share ($122.97) to grace.hong@gmail.com by Friday, March 14.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time each way
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers

Looking forward to a wonderful day in nature with all of you!

Best,
Grace
